text:
Priya Nair: Quick UX check: our in-product help panel and the docs site disagree on a few terms and link targets. Noticed during onboarding flow tests.

Ethan Cole: Can you paste the mismatches? screenshots help but short examples ok.

Priya Nair: Sure. Console runtime card labels the feature as 'Dedicated capacity', docs use 'Reserved instances'. Also the help panel's 'Get started' button points to /help/quickstart whereas canonical docs live at /docs/start.

Maya Ruiz: Visual mismatch too: sidecar header weight and spacing differ from Console standard — sidecar shows compact spacing which makes the title feel detached. Recommend matching Console header tokens.

Noah Kim: For copy I'd prefer we choose the docs canonical term and make Console show a combined label during transition: e.g., 'Dedicated capacity (Reserved instances)'. That makes search and support easier.

Priya Nair: Agreed. Also can we add a small inline cross-link under the label: 'See Reserved instances docs' that opens in a new tab?

Ethan Cole: Engineering: can the sidecar's link resolver take a list of aliases? If not, we'll add a redirect from /help/quickstart -> /docs/start.

Docs Bot: link-checker: /help/quickstart -> 404 (last scan).

Maya Ruiz: Accessibility: sidecar close button lacks an explicit aria-label; screen reader says just 'button'. Please change to aria-label="Close help panel" and ensure focus returns to the control that opened the panel.

Noah Kim: Dev note: focus-return is handled by the opener component but we have inconsistent ref handling across codebases. I'll consolidate and add a unit test.

Priya Nair: Action items: Ethan 1 - confirm redirect/alias support; Maya 1 - update mock header spacing and aria copy; Noah 1 - consolidate opener refs for focus-return; I'll add a docs ticket to standardize the lexicon and create the cross-link text.

Ethan Cole: I'll check redirects and report by EOD.

Docs Bot: Created issue #4602: "Canonical term: 'Reserved instances'; add alias /help/quickstart -> /docs/start; update in-product label to transitional form"

Priya Nair: Thanks all. These small fixes should cut down onboarding confusion and support churn. We'll track progress in this thread and the GH issue. :)
